question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Now compute the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        1 AS depth,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
),
leaves AS (
    SELECT id FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        SUM(pt.accumulated_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN leaves l ON l.id = pt.current_id
    GROUP BY pt.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS average_total_quantity
FROM root_totals

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    -- Base case: start from root packaging items (those that are never contained)
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        1 AS depth,
        1.0 AS accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: follow containment relationships
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
)

    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
)
